learning_outcomes.text: Students acquire the first basic knowledge required for developing AI systems from knowledge representation, language processing, image recognition, agents, adaptivity, and machine learning. Furthermore, an overview of the computer science-driven thinking and working methods of Artificial Intelligence is gained primarily through practical applications.
Students acquire formal competence so that they can formally describe initial problems. They successfully apply their AI knowledge in developing small AI solution concepts.
Students are able to roughly assess suitable AI tools for solving tasks. Through group work, students learn cooperation skills.
Students have basic knowledge of AI modeling and machine learning.
Students have an insight into solving problems through group work and teamwork.

Students have basic knowledge of AI methods for processing practical tasks such as language and image processing, software agents, knowledge representation, user modeling, and machine learning as a basis for understanding application solutions.
Students are capable of in-depth personal time management and self-study, as they work through approximately 25% of the material using virtual teaching.

syllabus_topics: Phasen der geschichtlichen KI-Entwicklung insb. Deutsche KI Geschichte
Wissensqualitäten – Wissen ist subjektiv – Wissen ist Kapital
Überblick über die Wissensrepräsentationen: Semantisches Netz/Ontologie, Produktionsregel, Inferenz mit Logik, Rand- und Nebenbedingungen (Constraints)
Einführung in Sprachverarbeitungssysteme – Chatbots zur Wissenskommunikation
Beispiel einer Wissensrepräsentation für Chatbots: AIML (Artificial Intelligence Markup Language)
Wovon sprechen wir, wenn wir von KI sprechen?
Realisierungen von KI-Systemen mit IBM Watson
Relevante KI- Entwicklungsbereiche für Europa und Deutschland
KI und Ethik sowie KI und Nachhaltigkeit
Repräsentation von Unsicherheit in Bayes Netzen
Multiplikationssatz und Inferenz im Bayes Netz
teaching_methods: Preparation of presence phases with digital materials (videos, self-tests)
assessment_rules: The module examination is a written exam of 90 minutes duration. The weighting of the grade is 5/210.
